text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that a Pedestrian Crossover (PXO) not be installed on Galloway Road at Coronation Drive as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. Currently, this location is controlled by a stop sign for westbound traffic on Coronation Drive at Galloway Road.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of a Pedestrian Crossover on Galloway Road at Coronation Drive.
